introduction.p: Suppose you have three dice: a 4-sided die, a 6-sided die, and an 8-sided die. Each die is fair and numbered from 1 to the number of sides it has. You roll all three dice.

statement.p: What is the probability that the sum of the dice is 3?
What is the probability that the sum of the dice is 6?

hint.p: You could list out all the ways you can get a 6, or use sticks and stones.

statement.p: What is the probability all three dice have the same number when rolled?
What is the probability all three dice have the same number when rolled given that the sum of the dice is 6?
